main_measure.name: mean unusual 5-bar move of short cases (short direction)

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases summed per day

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and check passes; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move, larger |forecast| half minus smaller half

decided_by: Confirm rule met: the mean unusual move is above 0 with t >= 2 and the larger-|forecast| half beats the smaller half.
reading: A case is the first short bet (a rise of the short forecast of at least 2 points) in each 5-bar grid cell counted from each window's first row; the t uses deviations from the mean summed per UTC day with no small-sample correction; the median split puts |forecast| above the median in the larger half and the rest in the smaller half; the situation check takes r5 from the recorded fall5 raw value and does not re-check the profile.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.01276 on the check folds against +0.02117 on every fold
